statements.statement: The patient presents with exertional dyspnea and palpitations
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is to evaluate for paroxysmal arrhythmias that may be contributing to these symptoms
The service is to guide further management of the underlying coronary and valvular pathology
The claim was denied under reason code CO-197
The service was denied because required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the date of service
